entries.1caafee052dcd7c0: A company that, centered on ABEJA Platform, provides end-to-end services from supporting the introduction of AI into companies' mission-critical operations to their operation.
entries.438b8abe8db27cf5: With the corporate philosophy "Implement a prosperous world," this is a single-segment company in the Digital Platform Business that develops, deploys and operates ABEJA Platform, the foundation system for supporting the introduction of AI into mission-critical operations.
entries.530717b2ee2ab10e: This domain handles operation through collaboration between people and AI on ABEJA Platform, and is positioned as the operation phase.
entries.f2507eaf8c79fbce: This domain handles operation through collaboration between people and AI on ABEJA Platform, and is positioned as the operation phase. Its main revenue is stock-type recurring revenue, and it currently covers multiple industries including retail, real estate, manufacturing and finance. As a specific example, it provides "ABEJA Insight for Retail," built on ABEJA Platform, mainly to the retail industry; through devices such as cameras installed in stores, it analyzes consumer flow lines and estimates age and gender, visualizing and quantifying consumer behavior from store entry to purchase, which leads to understanding store issues and improving operations. Sales results for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were 126.7% of the same period of the previous year, and 23.4% of the total.
entries.fc0de5e405c47889: This domain provides support for introducing ABEJA Platform in response to customer needs and its peripheral services, and is positioned as the system-building and construction phase. Because system building and construction proceed in stages, much of the revenue comes from flow-type (per-engagement) contracts; however, as it is a planned process over a long period, the proportion of repeat customers is high, and the share of revenue from repeat enterprise customers is 88.8% (fiscal year ended August 2025). It provides hands-on support from formulating and sharing management-level and company-wide visions, through planning to realize those visions, to introducing ABEJA Platform in line with business processes, and also promotes the development of in-house digital talent at customer companies through AI training and other programs. Sales results for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were 130.5% of the same period of the previous year, and 76.6% of the total.
